news.title: Phl kicks off historic U15 FIFA World Cup bid
news.lede: DT·24 October 2026 · 2:32 AM PHT·2 MIN READ. THE national men’s football team of Jonas Oliverio, Enrique Fernandez, Jordan Tan, Keanefred Versales, Matthew Zamora, Carlo Rendon, Juan Carlo Morales, Zhian Enario, Josef Peña, Nathan Caligdong, Micah Alva, and Dan Becera is expected to go all out when it competes in the FIFA U15 World Cup & Festival in Azerbaijan. The Philippine Men’s National Football Team (PMNFT) steps onto the Hovsan Competition Complex in Baku, Azerbaijan to open its campaign against Morocco in the inaugural FIFA U15 World Cup and Festival on Saturday. The roster showcases a wide talent pool spanning from Luzon and the Visayas to North America and Europe, with Jordan Tan of Makati FC and Keanefred Cristiane Versales of De La Salle-Zobel guiding the backline in goal.

news.title: Rugby League World Cup: Mikey Lewis on bench as England squad named for clash vs France after opening defeat
news.lede: England head coach Brian McDermott has made one change to his 19-man squad for Saturday's Rugby League World Cup match against France. AJ Brimson retains the job at full-back with Jack Welsby again named as an interchange, while Luke Thompson starts at prop in the absence of Morgan Knowles, who suffered an injury in the lead-up to the opening-game defeat to Tonga. Veteran centre Kallum Watkins is listed among the reserves as he chases a cap at his fourth World Cup, while Mikey Lewis returns to the bench after missing out on a place in the squad last time out. As per World Cup rules, each side is able to name a six-player bench in each game, but only four of the six players named can be brought on.
